title: Unique, Moderately Repetitive and Highly Repetitive DNA
method: Whitespace-delimited visible article text; narrative excludes diagrams, tables, question sections, references, headings and UI; full article includes headings, captions, questions and references, excludes SVG and enlargement controls.
comparator: 1.B.05 publication QA reports 7,946 narrative words and 10 diagrams; 2.B.10 reports 9,074 narrative words. This narrower Unit 2.C node extends sequence organization and abundance analysis while referring to 1.B.05 for duplex stability. Compare explanatory coverage, not raw HTML size.
scientific_checks: Official merged and separate CSIR Unit 2.C PDF pages visually inspected, archived MP SET 2024 scan corroborates. Reviewed Britten–Kohne 1968, Brown Genomes, Cooper, satellite and STR reviews, centromere and telomere exceptions, unequal exchange and rDNA concerted evolution. First draft review identified missing genome-size normalization, C-value example, late-stage kinetics, inverse-axis interpretation, alternate hypotheses, and crossover/telomere drawing details; revised and rechecked. Recalculated all worked examples and practice values, including 37.568151%, 15.0069993%, 900 seconds, 12,000 monomers and 1,000 higher-order repeats. Original synthetic data and question distractors checked.
limitations: Static source review, not actual interactive browser, device or rendered SVG testing. State SET syllabus verified via archived scan rather than current MPPSC-hosted original. Next 2.C.05 unavailable and unlinked. Pages deployment and live verification pending.
